facts.text: Move down, move down, clean cups all round! The jam tarts are fresh and the Dormouse is asleep in the teapot again.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as a character line, so it counts as a quote. The Hatter's real line is 'Clean cup, clean cup! Move down.' The longer version about jam tarts and the Dormouse is not in the film.
facts.fix: Clean cup, clean cup! Move down.

fix_note.text: Clean cup, clean cup! Move down.

vibe.verdict: The strongest of the batch, a proper tearoom with a Hatter price tag and a good look; only the note needs a real Hatter line.
